title: InstallPreferences
description:
The method and harnesses the last successful install saved, or the
environment default when nothing has been saved yet.

saved.description:
`false` when `method`/`harnesses` are an environment default rather
than a saved preference (no install has completed on this scope
yet).

InstallMethod.description: Which of the three ways `ops::install` can put a skill's bytes on disk.

oneOf.description:
Fetches or copies bytes and stages/swaps them into place directly -
no external CLI.

AgentIdentity.description:
Kebab-case harness identifier, for example `claude-code` or `opencode`.

Legacy spellings are normalized at input boundaries.
